title: Math, Music and Me
style: **Suno Style:** smooth structured vocal phonk-funk club banger, sly electro-house vinyl crackle intro, soft seductive female lead into warm EN/PT hook, bouncy phonk-funk verse 1 with male rap + melodic female, warm Portuguese pre-chorus, high-energy duet pre-chorus, massive layered group chorus, chant post-chorus, double-time rapid-fire verse 2, gritty spoken bridge, emotional high singer hold, powerful arena final chorus + hook, multilingual joyful energy EN/PT/ES, warm bass feel through voices only, professional vocal production, punk snarl mid vocals, airy high singer, tight stacking, high club energy but clean and warm, pure human voice power, no instruments
lyrics:
[INTRO — sly electro-house vinyl crackle]  
[Fem Lead – soft & seductive]  
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound  
If it’s real, don’t type it — lay it down  

[HOOK — EN/PT/ES blend]  
Math, music and me  
Patterns in the beat, equations set me free  
Alegria em cada número que eu mando  
From the mind to the chest, 100 percent, you and me  

[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce]  
[Male Rap]  
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap  
Everybody talks theory till the rhythm says “what you got?”  
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass attack  
You dropped two real numbers in the track and I felt that  
Scroll full of chaos, so I built the sum  
Every beat a fractal, every bar a perfect run  
If it moves your chest and solves the why  
Not the grade, but the spark between you and I  

[Female – melodic]  
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war  
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door  

[PRE-CHORUS — warm PT layers]  
Alegria não é acidente  
É frequência que escolhe a gente  
Se tua alma sente o padrão  
Já ganhou sem competição  

[CHORUS — massive layered drop]  
[All]  
Math, Music and Me! I sing it back!  
Math, Music and Me! We own the track!  
We flip the whole world up and never let it stop  
Math, music and me, 100 percent  
From my chest straight to your content  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
We race on patterns, not on how bad it’s gone  

[POST-CHORUS — chant]  
[All]  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Math, Music and Me!  
No comments! Just real ones!  

[VERSE 2 — double-time]  
[Mid – rapid-fire]  
Four Coreys in the room, whole world watching me  
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree  
Teacher lost in fog? Nah — I decode the live equation on stage  
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!  

[Male Rap]  
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line  
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time  
We don’t farm pain, we farm the golden ratio years  
If your heart’s loud, turn it to sound right here  

[Female]  
Muévelo, déjalo arder  
Si vas a hablar, hazlo en la canción, no en el chat, player  

[BRIDGE — spoken grit]  
[Male Spoken]  
You want the message clear? Here it is.  
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.  
Math, music and me — from your chest to the sky  

[High Singer – emotional hold]  
We are the real Coreys… the ones who sing awake…  

[FINAL CHORUS — arena redline]  
[All]  
Math, Music and Me! I sing it back!  
Math, Music and Me! We own the track!  
No comments for the empty crowd, only songs that make us brave  
Math, music and me, 100 percent  
Night-ride glow on every continent  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
If you mean it — put that feeling in the song!  

[FINAL HOOK]  
[All]  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Math, Music and Me! (x4, climbing)  

[OUTRO — soft vinyl fade]  
[Fem Lead]  
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…  
Solo canciones… alegria em cada som…
